title: Synergistic effects of H2O2 on the performance of nano-zero-valent manganese biochar (nZVMn/PBC) for the treatment of chlorpyrifos from aqueous solution
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,44229-44245
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA06773A, Paper
Open Access

Muhammad Aftab, Zia Ul Haq Khan, Noor Samad Shah, Maryam Zahid, Jingyu Sun, Mahmood M. S. Abdullah, Fida Ullah, Syed Khasim
This study explores the efficient degradation of the highly toxic organophosphorus pesticide chlorpyrifos (CPY) from aqueous solution using a novel nano-zero-valent manganese-decorated plant biochar composite (nZVMn/PBC).
